visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up screen recording of a social media post on a monitor, featuring Traditional Chinese text about an iPhone storage tip. A hand points at the screen. (2) Scene shifts to a bright office where a young woman with long dark hair and a white shirt is speaking directly to the camera with high energy and hand gestures. (3) A close-up shot of an iPhone screen follows, showing hands navigating through settings, turning on Airplane Mode, and changing the date to 2026. (4) The video cuts between the woman's excited reactions in the office and the phone screen as the date is set back to automatic. (5) The final sequence displays the iPhone's storage management screen updating to show a significant reduction in used space, while the woman celebrates with a wide-eyed, joyful expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic female narrator begins speaking over an upbeat acoustic guitar background track. The music has a steady, mid-tempo rhythm. The vocal tone is bright and professional. (2) A second female voice joins in a conversational manner, expressing disbelief. The interaction is lively. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals a visual transition. (3) As the phone settings are adjusted, the narration becomes more instructional while maintaining high energy. The music volume remains stable beneath the voices. (4) Both women scream in excitement as the result is revealed, creating a high-arousal vocal peak. A loud 'impact' SFX emphasizes the storage clearance. (5) The video concludes with rapid-fire celebratory speech and laughter. The music fades out quickly after a final 'ding' notification sound effect.
